tasks.short: Recruit parent volunteers and older pupils as helpers for class activities, brief them and guide the activity.

steps.what: Teacher plans the activity and decides how many helpers are needed
Teacher asks parent volunteers for help through the parent app
Parents reply and offer to help on a date
Teacher keeps the helper list and chases parents to fill gaps
Teacher arranges older students as buddies with their class teacher
Colleague teacher picks and prepares older students for the activity
Teacher briefs volunteers and buddies on their role before the activity
Teacher guides the children's activity together with volunteers and buddies

tasks.design: Configure slot-based sign-up in the parent app of the pupil records system ({OTHER}): the teacher posts the activity with slots, parents pick a slot, reminders go out the day before, and open slots show on the teacher's list. A short instruction card per activity type in {DOCS} goes with the reminder, so the in-class briefing is shorter.
tasks.previous_blocker: Volunteer requests ran through chat threads and a paper list, so tracking replies took repeated messages.
tasks.enabler_now: Parent apps support sign-up slots and reminders as standard features.
tasks.still_hard: Some parents never use the app, and a good activity depends on how the teacher guides helpers in the moment.
tasks.human_edge: Making volunteers and older pupils feel useful and steering complex play so every child takes part.

ambition.what: Parents who work irregular hours and can now pick a slot that fits, instead of answering a group chat in time.

tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in decision rights; less chasing of replies.

reach.task: Organise parent help for play activities
reach.learn: Whether the same sign-up slots work for younger children's groups.

evidence.claim: A Dutch pupil records system comes with a parent app.
Parent apps can offer sign-up slots and reminders.
Regular volunteers working with children may need a certificate of conduct under national rules; parent contact data falls under GDPR.

assumptions: Boundary: from planning the activity to guiding it; the activity's content is outside.

Input contract: parent contact details and class membership, produced by the school administration in the pupil records system; slots per activity set by the teacher in s2; fallback is the class chat.
Parent and colleague time is outside the teacher's savings.
unknowns: Whether the school's parent app has sign-up slots.
How many activities per term need helpers.
research_questions: Does slot sign-up reach parents who did not volunteer before?

already_counted.description: Teacher checks the sign-up list and messages parents about open slots.

incremental.description: Teacher keeps instruction cards per activity type current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: In a class where many parents ignore the app, the teacher keeps chasing by chat and the list saving shrinks.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Run a school club or enter a team in a contest: agree it, sign pupils up, register, coach and organise the day.

steps.what: Teacher proposes the club or contest to the school leader with dates and costs
School leader approves the activity plan and budget
Teacher announces the extracurricular activity and collects sign-ups and consent forms
Parents sign their child up and give consent
Teacher registers the school team on the contest organiser's site
Teacher plans club sessions and prepares practice materials
Teacher runs club sessions or coaches the contest team
Teacher arranges parent drivers and supervisors for contest day

tasks.design: Use a sign-up form with a consent box in the parent app of the pupil records system ({OTHER}), so the participant list and consents build themselves, and the same slot sign-up for parent drivers and supervisors. Registration with the organiser stays a manual entry on the {PARTNER_PORTAL} after the school leader's approval of plan and budget.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sign-ups and consent came back on paper slips that the teacher counted and filed.
tasks.enabler_now: Parent apps offer forms with consent and sign-up slots.
tasks.still_hard: Coaching and running the club is the work; organisers' sites cannot be linked.
tasks.human_edge: Spotting talent, keeping children motivated and handling nerves on contest day.

ambition.what: Children whose parents never returned paper slips, now reached by a one-tap sign-up.

tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in decision rights; less paper to count and chase.

reach.learn: Whether the same sign-up and consent form fits paid courses.

evidence.claim: A Dutch pupil records system comes with a parent app.
Sharing pupils' names with a contest organiser needs a lawful basis and parental consent for anything beyond the school's public task.

assumptions: Boundary: from proposing the activity to contest day organised; the contest itself is outside.

Input contract: parent contact details and class membership from the school administration in the pupil records system; form fields and consent text set by the teacher from the school's template; fallback is paper slips.
School leader and parent time is outside the teacher's savings.
Coaching and session planning are unchanged.
unknowns: Whether the parent app supports consent forms.
How many clubs or contests a teacher runs per year.
research_questions: Do more children join when sign-up moves to the app?

already_counted.description: Teacher checks that every signed-up child has a consent before the list closes.

incremental.description: Teacher sets up the form and slots for each activity.

approvals.approved_version: Activity plan with dates, number of pupils and budget as approved in s2; a larger team or fee needs a new approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A small club with a few regular members gives little sign-up work to save; coaching dominates.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The teacher keeps the activities, coaching and contact with helpers; chasing replies and paper slips shrink.
skills_to_grow: Setting up sign-ups and consent forms in the parent app
Briefing helpers with a short card
role.ambitious_version: A teacher who runs more clubs and parent-supported activities because sign-up, consent and rosters take minutes.

job.title: Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education
